verses.1: In the eighth month, in the year of Darius’ reign, God spoke to Zechariah ben Berechiah, the prophet, with these words:
verses.2: The anger of the LORD is upon your ancestors. It’s a terrible wrath from the LORD.
verses.3: And you said to them, “Thus says the LORD Almighty: Come back to me, oh armies of God! Let us return to you, O armies of God!” And the LORD Almighty said, “I will come back to you.”
verses.4: Do not be like those who were called by the ancient prophets, when they said, “Thus says the LORD: Return from your evil paths and from your harmful ways!” But they did not listen to them or pay attention to them. Alas, LORD!
verses.5: Your ancestors, who are now in heaven, will live forever.
verses.6: But my words and laws, which I commanded my servants, the prophets, they did not obey. They did not follow them. Instead, they said, “When Jehovah’s army is ready to do what we desire and as we desire, then He will act for us.” And so it happened.
verses.7: On the forty-fourth day of the twelfth month, this was the month of Shevat in the year of Darius. It was a time when God spoke to Zechariah ben Berechiah, the prophet.
verses.8: I saw last night that a man was riding on a human horse. He stood among the hawthorns that were in the field. Behind him were other horses, with feathers and decorations on them.
verses.9: And he said, “What are these?” The angel replied, “They are the words spoken by the angel. I will show you what they mean.”
verses.10: And the man who stood among the thorns said, “These are those whom Jehovah sent to walk in the land.”
verses.11: And they answered the angel of the LORD, who was standing among the stars. They said, “We have walked through the land, and behold, the whole land is quiet and peaceful.”
verses.12: And the angel of the LORD said, “Lord, your armies will not show mercy on Jerusalem and the cities of Judah, because you have become angry for seventy years.”
verses.13: And the LORD answered the angel who spoke to him with good words and comforting messages.
verses.14: And the angel said to me, “The Lord has spoken through me. He says, ‘I am longing for Jerusalem and Zion with great longing.’”
verses.15: And I am extremely angry with those nations who are so arrogant. I have been angry with them for a long time, and yet they still helped the evil ones.
verses.16: Therefore, as Jehovah has said, “I will return to Jerusalem with mercy. My house will be rebuilt there.” May Jehovah’s army and His voice be upon Jerusalem.
verses.17: And He said, “As the Lord has said, His armies will again be destroyed. Good cities will be destroyed, but the Lord will still choose Jerusalem.”
